# SnapTools 🛠️ • Architectural Workstation [![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-online-blueviolet.svg)](https://snaptools.xyz) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Made with React](https://img.shields.io/badge/Made%20with-React-61dafb.svg)](https://reactjs.org/) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-007ACC?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) > **SnapTools** is a professional-grade architectural workstation providing 100+ specialized modules for developers, designers, and digital architects. Engineered for technical precision, it offers a seamless high-fidelity experience with **zero ads**, **zero tracking**, and **local-first execution**. 🔗 **[Live Demo](https://snaptools.xyz)** | 📖 **[Documentation](https://snaptools.xyz/documentation)** | 🐛 **[Report Bug](https://github.com/iam-sandipmaity/SnapTools/issues)** | ✨ **[Request Feature](https://github.com/iam-sandipmaity/SnapTools/issues)** ## 🛰️ Module Ecosystem ### Specialized Suites - **PDF Architecture**: Merge, split, and compress documents with high-fidelity logic. - **Imaging Suite**: Neural image reduction and advanced format transformation. - **Universal Converters**: Real-time currency/crypto synchronization and technical unit translation. - **Logical Runners**: Secure code execution environment for JS, Python, C++, and more. - **SecOps Utilities**: Entropy-driven generators and secure cryptographic hash verification. - **Social Media Engine**: High-resolution thumbnail extraction and engagement generation. - **SEO & Web Ops**: Open Graph protocols, meta-architecture, and edge-delivery optimization. - **Unified Registry**: Over 100+ specialist tools organized into professional categories. ### Core Principles - **100+ Mission-Critical Modules**: A comprehensive directory of pro-grade utilities. - **Architectural Workstation UI**: Premium glassmorphic interface with advanced motion design. - **Privacy-First Protocol**: Client-side execution ensures your data never leaves your hardware. - **Edge Performance**: Globally distributed assets and millisecond-latency processing. - **Technical Typography**: Oversized serif headers and precise mono-spaced data displays. ## 🚀 Tech Stack ### Frontend Architecture - **Framework**: React 18 (TypeScript) - **Engine**: Vite 5.x (Hardware-accelerated HMR) - **Design System**: Tailwind CSS (Architectural Workstation Protocol) - **Motion Engine**: Framer Motion (High-fidelity micro-interactions) - **UI Primitives**: Radix UI & shadcn/ui - **Logic Sync**: Axios with specialized API integrations (Coingecko, ExchangeRate) ### Development Environment - **Type Safety**: TypeScript 5.x (Strict Mode) - **Formatting**: Prettier & ESLint (Professional Standard) - **Package Manager**: npm/yarn/pnpm ## 🚦 Getting Started ### Prerequisites - Node.js (v18.x or higher) - Git ### Installation 1. **Clone the Repository** ```bash git clone https://github.com/iam-sandipmaity/SnapTools.git cd SnapTools ``` 2. **Initialize Environment** ```bash npm install ``` 3. **Launch Discovery Server** ```bash npm run dev ``` The workstation will be available at `http://localhost:5173` ## 📊 Logic Structure ``` src/ ├── components/ # UI Atoms and Specialist Tool Modules ├── data/ # Architectural Configurations and Registry ├── hooks/ # Custom Stateful Logic Protocols ├── lib/ # Core API Integrations and Utilities ├── pages/ # Full-Scale Workstation Views ├── sections/ # High-Impact Hero and Content Sections ├── services/ # External Logic Connectors (Code Execution, APIs) └── utils/ # Technical Helpers ``` ## ⚡ Performance Optimization - **Architectural Code Splitting**: Route-centric lazy loading for zero overhead. - **Neural Motion Design**: Hardware-accelerated animations for smooth transitions. - **Sitemap & SEO Protocol**: Dynamic metadata and structured data for search visibility. - **PWA Ready**: Desktop-class installable experience for total workflow integration. ## 🤝 Contributing Contributions propel the SnapTools ecosystem forward. We welcome digital architects of all levels to enhance this open-source workstation. 1. Fork the Repository 2. Initialize Feature Branch (`git checkout -b feature/AmazingFeature`) 3. Commit Logic Changes (`git commit -m 'Implement: AmazingFeature'`) 4. Synchronize Branch (`git push origin feature/AmazingFeature`) 5. Initialize Pull Request ## 📄 License SnapTools is distributed under the MIT License. See `LICENSE` for the complete manifesto. ## 🙏 Acknowledgments - **The Open Source Community** for the foundational libraries that power this ecosystem. - **Vercel** for hosting the global edge delivery. - **All Contributors** who help scale these 100+ modules. ## 📧 Intelligence Contact **Sandip Maity** - [@iam-sandipmaity](https://github.com/iam-sandipmaity) Workstation Link: [https://snaptools.xyz](https://snaptools.xyz) ---
